notes_for_editor: History is thin: the only build year, design and registration facts come from one NHLR entry. The Forest Lookouts page for Jack Pine (centraluslookouts.weebly.com/jack-pine.html) shows only a header, so it was not cited. A Wisconsin Historical Society post in search results mentions a 1935 CCC move and a 1936 cabin, but the page returned only a login stub and does not name the tower; it was not used. Mountain Fire Lookout (Forest Service) was built in 1935, which may be what that post describes. Whether Jack Pine was among the 72 DNR towers in the 2016 plan is not confirmed. Staffing, fires, access and visit details not found. The anyplaceamerica and peakery pages were not cited; peakery lists no climbs.
